## 正文

## Dev Engineer Review

- Telemetry extraction now uses the first Hugging Face `architectures` entry. It uses the config class name only when the list is absent or empty. It no longer reads the legacy singular field or nested engine config.
- Backend telemetry no longer infers a backend from the args class name. Reports without an explicit backend omit the backend value. CUDA graph telemetry now depends only on `cuda_graph_config`.
- The changes remove legacy compatibility paths without changing exported APIs. The schema guide updates its architecture and backend guidance. Current review findings and test-run results were not supplied.

## QA Engineer Review

- `tests/unittest/usage/test_collectors.py` updates tests for architecture extraction, backend omission, and CUDA graph detection. It removes test coverage for legacy architecture shapes and the legacy TensorRT CUDA graph setting.
- `tests/unittest/usage/test_llmapi_config_telemetry_docs.py` changes its manifest fixture and subprocess test from `TrtLlmArgs` to `ZArgs`.
- `tests/unittest/docs/test_llmapi_reference_docs.py` adds `test_generate_llmapi_excludes_pydantic_members_only`. It checks generated reference exclusions for a Pydantic model and a non-model.
- `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml` adds the reference-doc test. No matching entries were found for the two modified usage test files, and no matching manual-QA list entries were found.
- **Coverage verdict: needs follow-up.** The tests no longer cover the removed legacy paths. Validate telemetry behavior with representative live args that provide explicit backend values and `cuda_graph_config`.

## Per-File QA Perspective

- `docs/source/helper.py`: Generated reference pages now add Pydantic-member exclusions only for Pydantic models. The added test for this behavior is listed in `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`.
- `tensorrt_llm/usage/usage_lib.py`: Verify architecture fallback behavior, backend omission when args lack a backend, and CUDA graph reporting from `cuda_graph_config` alone.
- `tensorrt_llm/usage/schemas/README.md`: Verify that the updated architecture and backend guidance matches emitted telemetry. The guide removes the `quant_config.quant_algo` example row.
- `tests/unittest/usage/test_collectors.py`: Updates collector coverage for architecture extraction, backend reporting, and CUDA graph detection. No matching test-list entry was found.
- `tests/unittest/usage/test_llmapi_config_telemetry_docs.py`: Uses `ZArgs` instead of `TrtLlmArgs` in the manifest fixture and subprocess test. No matching test-list entry was found.
- `tests/unittest/docs/test_llmapi_reference_docs.py`: Tests generated reference exclusions for a Pydantic model and a non-model. It is listed in `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`.
- `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`: Adds `unittest/docs/test_llmapi_reference_docs.py` to the CPU CI list.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`: Adds a pattern that assigns files under `/tests/unittest/docs` to `@NVIDIA/trt-llm-doc-owners`.

## Description

The legacy TensorRT execution backend is gone, but usage collection still recognized its checkpoint and engine config shapes, inferred a TensorRT backend from argument class names, and read its CUDA graph setting. Those branches were reachable only through compatibility mocks and obscured the current PyTorch and AutoDeploy telemetry behavior.

Read architecture names from the first Hugging Face architectures entry, report backend values supplied by the live args, and derive CUDA graph usage from cuda_graph_config. Remove the corresponding mock-only tests and the TrtLlmArgs special case in API documentation generation. Refresh the schema guide and cleanup report to describe the active behavior.

Keep the existing telemetry event fields, schema version, backend field, and historical tensorrt value in schema documentation. Downstream SMS and dashboard consumers still depend on the wire contract. The LLM args golden manifest is unchanged.
